technology_name: STEEL FIBRE REINFORCED RUBCRETE CRASH BARRIERS
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
technology_type: Highway Safety Hardware / Recycled Rubcrete Compound
problem_solved: Highways require heavy impact-resistant median structures that utilize recycled industrial rubber waste streams effectively without losing durability or life cycle thresholds.
description: A specialized roadside safety barrier component utilizing a hybrid steel-fiber and pre-treated crumb rubber concrete matrix designed to consistently outperform standard concrete structures by absorbing over 3.25 times more kinetic collision energy.
applications: Smart city expressway barriers, race track outer safety walls, industrial facility protection columns, and high-impact loading docks.
secondary_sector: Advanced Materials & Chemical, Energy, Climate & Sustainability, Water, Environment & Waste Management
